changes.distinct_reobservation: A retry after a reached wrist view must use a different candidate at least 40 mm away; if none exists, execution fails closed with REOBSERVATION_UNAVAILABLE.
changes.bounded_contact_retry: A failed close may reopen and try one collision-checked orthogonal finger orientation; the dual-contact attachment gate remains unchanged.
changes.plant_support: Generalized fruit starts constrained to a world-fixed plant support. The support releases only after fresh dual contact and confirmed gripper attachment; failed release rolls the gripper attachment back.
changes.initial_scene_safety: Generated fruit collision spheres retain at least 2 mm clearance from the collection-bin outer volume. Reachability labels additionally require the same 70 mm static-obstacle centre clearance implied by the 50 mm static margin and 20 mm target gate.
changes.unchanged_gates: The 15 mm base and wrist uncertainty gates, 50 mm wrist correction gate, 20 mm target clearance gate, MoveIt collision/IK checks, and dual-contact attachment verification were not relaxed.

empty_gripper.interpretation: Both finger control channels move correctly without nearby geometry.
